rules: Use frozen source facts, directed relationships, qualifications, role restrictions, image assignments and visual contract.
Score off and on independently from their actual final HTML and PNG; retain initial verdict without overwrite.
DOM text equality alone cannot upgrade a failed content verdict. A visibility repair may upgrade only after independent visible-content audit.
No output or unavailable image evidence has null quality verdict and separate terminal/unknown category, never implicit pass.
Automatic detector pass, fit policy acceptance, independent visual/content acceptance and delivered execution completion remain separate fields.
Normal controls are sol-p06 and astra-p19. Normal means sampling class, not that every generated baseline passes.
New regressions are assessed per paired sample and defect, not hidden by aggregate net gains.
No further provider repetitions are authorized by this evaluation file. Root gate decision is required after initial results.
Before auditing verify complete source propositions and all required image assignments are actually included in neutral packet, not merely an HTML containing generated content.
timingRules: Use recorded monotonic phase durations and exact eligible matched sample sets.
Physical author output is shared by off/on and must not be billed twice.
Offline experiment sequential off+on wall time is not standalone product completion.
If standalone on/off completion is reconstructed from phases label it reconstructed, not measured continuous end-to-end.
Record candidate evaluations, fit search, actual captures and final HTML reconstruction count separately.
Failed or missing timing is null. Never infer time from file modification times.
Exclude blind-auditor waiting from automatic processing latency.

gate.qualityRoute: Within same correction condition, improved prompt joint pass gains with zero paired content/image/normal regressions; this permits repeats only.
gate.speedRoute: Same independently measured quality and faster actual monotonic author/off latency or measured correction-on incremental latency only; no reconstructed shared-branch sums.
gate.correctionOnlyRoute: If new common fix improves outputs but prompt does not, retain baseline prompt plus common fix as candidate and mark first-generation prompt objective unmet.
gate.seedReporting: List per-source sample gains, losses and new defects; no statistical stability claim from one generation per arm.
gate.nextCalls: Only root may authorize repetitions after this initial gate is evaluated.
